Complete the new engine setup first
The v2 unified decision engine does not read old rules or migrate old data. Before using it, enable only the minimum permissions you need, then add controlled apps and rules again.
Accessibility service is required to identify the foreground app, read page class names or keywords, and go home when interception fails. Without it, the new engine cannot work reliably.
Display-over-apps permission is recommended for intervention and challenge screens. Without it, matching rules fail closed to the home screen instead of showing an overlay.
Notification permission is only used for service and permission alerts. Notification access is only needed when you use background media blocking or diagnostics. Do not grant everything up front.

Add apps: return to the main screen, open Add app, and choose apps to control.

Add rules: open an app rule screen and configure challenges, per-app daily/session/continuous limits, and open counts. Phone-wide usage is configured from Phone usage limit.

Note: v2 is not compatible with old rules. If old pages show old data, treat it as reference only; effective rules must be written by the v2 rule configuration flow.
I completed setup; enter the main screen
Next you will enter Android notification access settings. Only enable the top-level notification access grant.

It is only used to read media session package names and try to pause audio when a restricted app keeps playing in the background. For example, if a video app keeps playing after you leave it, AddictionBuster asks Android media controls to pause it.
What you do not need to enable
You do not need separate real-time, conversation, notification, or silent-content permissions. Those are Android\'s general notification-access warnings, not data that this app needs to read.
A normal APK cannot freeze or force-stop other apps. This feature can only request a background media pause; foreground app opening is handled by the accessibility interception service.
Foreground interception still works without this permission; background audio may simply keep playing.
After reproducing a problem, tap Send diagnostics to developer. The report includes version, permission state, recent key events, and the last hour of logs.
